description: Defines the PlayerWorker class and its nested Handler class, which manage threading, event handling, and media playback operations for a platform-specific media player implementation.

classes.name: PlayerWorker
classes.description: Manages a dedicated thread and event queue for media playback, providing methods to control playback state, seek, write samples, and handle errors.

classes.name: PlayerWorker::Handler
classes.description: Interface for handling media events and operations, to be implemented by platform-specific subclasses.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a PlayerWorker instance with specified codecs, handler, and callback functions.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Schedules a seek operation to a specified media time.

methods.name: WriteSamples
methods.description: Schedules writing of input media samples.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Schedules signaling end of stream for a media type.

methods.name: SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Schedules changing the playback rate, with clamping to a valid range.
